_comment: Settings → General hero card. Edited here and fetched by the app at runtime, so plan copy and sponsors change WITHOUT shipping a build. Data only — every field renders as escaped text, never as markup. Unknown fields are ignored; anything malformed falls back to the app's built-in defaults. URLs must be https. Live plan badge in-app comes from EntitlementStore; this file is marketing copy + upgrade CTA.

plan.label: Community
plan.blurb: Full Classic floor on your machine. Pro trial unlocks the compact sidebar and Stapler; checkout stays on the web — the app never sees card numbers.
